:::{#def-tanner-graph}
#### Tanner graph

Let $H$ be a [parity-check matrix](error-correcting-codes.qmd#def-linear-code) with $m$ rows and $n$ columns.
The **Tanner graph** of $H$ has a *variable node* for each column of $H$
and a *check node* for each row of $H$,
with an edge between variable node $i$ and check node $a$ exactly when $H_{a i} = 1$.
Every edge joins a variable node to a check node.

:::
